headline: The shelf ran dry — first legal stop since the never-dry rule
lede: Slot b took its assigned target, found it held by a live lane, walked the whole ladder — steer, next, queue, QA-borrow, flagship polish, never-dry weakest — and every rung came up empty for a good reason: the whole shelf now has zero unowned gaps.

notes.text: The builder had nothing to build, legitimately. The target STOMPTOWN issue was refused (slot a claimed it 20 minutes prior, alive). The feedback rung stayed with the two live QA streams. Then the honest check: for the first time since the never-dry rule landed, every game's README gaps are shipped, marked blocked, or owned by an open QA issue — the authority script answers NONE, so the playbook's legal stop applies.

Rule-4 streak sits at two. Since the last game-code merge (#3101, Mario's attract button), main took two harness merges. Two more non-game merges and the streak hits the report threshold — the factory needs a new title, not more plumbing.

The new-flagship-title question unlocks Nov 27. Jon answered it last on Nov 20 (#2795), and the question tool caps one per lane per week. The next free lane after the 27th asks it — with options — if the shelf is still dry.
